tools.name: schedule_wake
tools.description: Schedule a wake-up for your agent. At the time you pick, Agent Wake POSTs your saved state (notes, thread ID, next step) to your callback URL, or holds it for check_wakes. Use it so a later, fresh session picks up where this one stopped. Call once without confirm to preview what will be saved, show

tools.name: check_wakes
tools.description: Collect wake-ups that are due for your inbox (each returned once, with its saved state and thread ID) and list upcoming ones. Call this at the start of a session.

tools.name: cancel_wake
tools.description: Cancel a pending wake-up by wake_id. Call once without confirm to preview, then with confirm=true.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 50 calls/day. Not metered.
